panes.title: SIZE OF ONE CUT
panes.sub: how much new supply disappears at once

panes.title: WHAT THAT MEANS
lines: *105,844 fewer KAS* minted every day from now on.

post.x: the kaspa block reward fell 5.61 percent this morning. bitcoin does 50 percent once every four years. kaspa does one small step every month, and twelve of them land on the same 50 percent. the network now mints 105,844 fewer KAS per day, emission went from 1.89 million to 1.78 million.
post.reply: the live emission numbers are on kaspapulse.com/kaspa-halving.html. the exact minute drifts, the cut lands on a block score, not a clock.
